en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5) 11.17.
Sanidassanattika, Vedanāttikādi (The Triplet on the Visible, etc., and the Triplets beginning with Feeling)

Dependent on a state that is non-visual, non-reactive, and dissociated from neither-painful-nor-pleasant feeling … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: thirty; under object-condition: nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: thirty.

Dependent on a state that is non-visual, non-reactive, and dissociated from painful feeling … (Abbreviated. Under root-condition: thirty; under object-condition: nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: thirty.

A state with an internal object arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and with an internal object, a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and with an internal object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are thirty;
under object condition, nine ... [etc. ... under mutuality condition, twenty-five ... [etc. ... under non-disappearance condition, thirty. (Full detail for all.)

there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not having an external object, by way of root condition. Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and not having an external object,

and not having the external as its object, by way of root condition … (six).
